mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS success, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(duration_millis)), 0) AS average_duration_millis, COALESCE(MAX(duration_millis), 0) AS max_duration_millis FROM ops_job_log WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time < #{endTime}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS success, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failed, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(duration_millis)), 0) AS average_duration_millis, COALESCE(MAX(duration_millis), 0) AS max_duration_millis FROM ops_job_log WHERE is_deleted = 0
AND job_id = #{jobId}

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM ops_job_log WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY DATE(create_time)

SELECT COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN row_num = CEIL(total * 0.95) THEN duration_millis END), 0 ) FROM ( SELECT duration_millis, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY duration_millis) AS row_num, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total FROM ops_job_log WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND job_id = #{jobId} AND duration_millis IS NOT NULL ) ranked

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ops_job_log failed WHERE failed.is_deleted = 0 AND failed.job_id = #{jobId} AND failed.status = 2 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ops_job_log success WHERE success.is_deleted = 0 AND success.job_id = failed.job_id AND success.status = 1 AND ( success.create_time > failed.create_time OR (success.create_time = failed.create_time AND success.id > failed.id) ) )

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM ops_job_log WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND job_id = #{jobId} AND create_time >= #{startTime} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY DATE(create_time)
mapper.update: UPDATE ops_job_log log SET status = 2, end_time = #{endTime}, result_message = '执行节点中断', exception_class = 'SchedulerInterrupted', exception_message = 'Quartz 执行记录已不存在' WHERE log.status = 0 AND log.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM qrtz_fired_triggers fired WHERE fired.entry_id = log.fire_instance_id )
